prompt_lessons: duration_seconds is only a cap. With lyrics '[Instrumental]' alone the model stops after about 24 s.

Section tags such as [Verse] / [Chorus] fill the length but invite wordless singing; instrument section tags ([Piano Solo], [Interlude], [Strings Solo], [Flute Solo], [Break], [Outro]) fill it without voices.

Listing what to avoid ('no singing, humming, choir ...') did not help and may have primed voices; a positive 'Pure instrumental ... for piano and strings only' plus 'Vocal Details: None' worked better.

A take that runs to the cap is cut mid-phrase. For a one-shot cue, cap the length above the planned end and describe the ring-out ('decays naturally to complete silence; nothing new starts after the final chord').
